items.description: Relations between Russia and North Korea have been flourishing, with North Korea supplying ammunition and troops to support Russia's war against Ukraine in return for economic and military assistance.

items.title: Yemeni forces launch counteroffensive against Houthis, vow to retake Sanaa
items.description: Bid to take the capital comes as clashes between Yemeni forces and Houthis intensify in the provinces of al-Bayda and al-Jawf.

items.title: Live: At least two killed in Kyiv as Russia renews strikes after three-day pause
items.description: Russia resumed strikes on Kyiv late Monday after a three-day pause ordered by President Vladimir Putin expired, Ukraine’s emergency service said. items.description: Allarme aereo nella capitale ucraina, edifici colpiti alla periferia della città

items.title: French Foreign Legion soldier escaped Colombian captors after four-day trek
items.description: The Colombian soldier in the French Foreign Legion who was abducted by guerillas on August 6 has managed to escape, the French Armed Forces General Staff announced on Monday.

items.title: Thousands turn out in Serbia for funeral of 'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladić
items.description: Mladić was jailed for genocide during the 1990s Bosnian war and the EU warned Serbia not to glorify the convicted war criminal.

items.title: Serbia Honors 'Butcher Of Bosnia' Ratko Mladic, Drawing Outrage Over Glorification
items.description: Thousands attended the Belgrade funeral for convicted war criminal Ratko Mladic, who died while serving a life sentence for genocide, war crimes, and crimes against humanity. items.title: Human rights chief Türk renews call for end to spiralling Sudan war
items.description: The ongoing war in Sudan took centre stage at the UN Human Rights Council on Monday where the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, Volker Türk, led calls for an end to attacks on civilians in “markets, hospitals [and] fuel stations”.

items.title: US envoys Witkoff and Kushner hold Ukraine talks after meeting Putin
items.description: US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in Kyiv, seeking to revive efforts to end the war. But the latest diplomatic push seems to have produced no breakthrough.

items.title: Russia’s Lavrov Calls Accusations of Moscow’s Involvement in Leipzig Drone Incident ‘Start of Real War'
items.description: The German government said last week that Russia was responsible for an attempted drone attack at Leipzig/Halle Airport.

items.title: Putin meets with US envoys for renewed talks on ending the war in Ukraine
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin met with U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner to try to revive a push to end the Russia-Ukraine war.
